prompt: Which products are creating the highest inventory exposure?
planSummary: Four agents check sales, stock age, costs, and returns to find products with the most money tied up.

agents.name: Sales Billing Agent
agents.runtimePrompt: Get sales for the last 90 days. Group the results by product and return units sold each week.

agents.name: Inventory Intelligence Agent
agents.runtimePrompt: Check current stock and receipt dates. Group products by stock age and flag products with more than 60 days of stock.

agents.name: Finance Agent
agents.runtimePrompt: For each flagged product, calculate stock cost after expected returns. Return the total and list products from highest to lowest.

agents.name: Executive Synthesis Agent
agents.runtimePrompt: Rank products by money tied up. Summarize the top 10 and suggest markdown or reorder actions.

suggestedAgents.name: Competitor Pricing Agent
suggestedAgents.description: Compares our prices with marketplace prices.
suggestedAgents.rationale: No active agent can read competitor prices.
suggestedAgents.runtimePrompt: Get current marketplace prices for the flagged products and show where our prices are higher.
